context: A teacher walks a teen through social research
purpose: Teach: 前線/最前線/対峙/誹謗/出頭/無垢/撃た/説く

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、戦争の前線、本当に、丁寧に、論じていますね、研究の深さ、本当に、印象的でした、本当に、立派な、研究、できました、桜さん、感心しました、本当に。
lines.en: Sakura, your paper — the way you argued the war frontline so carefully, the depth of your research was truly striking. It was genuinely impressive work. I really admired it.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Steady pace, slight pause between thoughts. Voice carries respect and genuine recognition without flattery. Eyes engaged, nodding slightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。報道の最前線、戦時下、本当に、危険な仕事だったんですね、論文で、扱いました、当時の記者、本当に、勇気、ありましたよね、頭が下がる、思いです、私、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The reporters on the front lines during wartime — it was such dangerous work, wasn't it? I handled that in my paper. The journalists of that era showed real courage. It's humbling to study it.
lines.style: Sincere, thoughtful tempo. Leaning slightly forward with focus. Soft intensity on the words about courage. Not performing — thinking through what she's saying even as she says it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文化と文化が、対峙する場面、論文で、深く、論じていますね、本当に、貴重な、視点でした、桜さん、これからの、研究にも、繋がる、テーマでしたね、本当に、感心。
lines.en: The moment where cultures faced each other — you examined that so deeply in your paper. It was a really valuable perspective. And it's a theme that will carry into your future research as well. I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Reflective, encouraging tone. Slower pace, allowing weight to each sentence. Hands open slightly. Voice has the quality of someone seeing potential and wanting to name it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時下の誹謗、敵国民への、本当に、深刻なものでしたね、論文で、丁寧に、論じました、現代の、社会問題にも、繋がる視点、含めて、書きました、本当に、深い研究。
lines.en: Yes. The wartime slander against enemy nationals was deeply serious, wasn't it? I argued that carefully in my paper. I also included perspectives that connect to modern social issues — I wanted the research to go deeper.
lines.style: Focused, direct delivery. Slight rise on key points but grounded in seriousness. Speaking with quiet conviction about her own work. Not asking permission, but not boasting either.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦犯の出頭、戦後の、本当に、複雑な、政治情勢の中で、行われたんですよね、論文の中で、丁寧に、論じていましたね、桜さん、本当に、視野が、広いですね、本当に、感心しました。
lines.en: The surrender of war criminals, the complex political situation after the war — you handled all of that so carefully in your paper, Sakura. Your perspective is really broad. I was deeply impressed by that.
lines.style: Engaged, slightly animated on key phrases. Leans forward with genuine interest. Pacing builds subtly as she acknowledges the scope of her work. Voice carries real admiration.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦争で、無垢な子供たちが、本当に、犠牲になった事実、論文で、扱いました、本当に、悲しい、歴史です、絶対、繰り返してはならないと、強く、訴えました、論文で。
lines.en: Yes. The fact that innocent children were sacrificed in war — I addressed that in my paper. It's such a sad part of history. I wanted to argue strongly that it must never happen again.
lines.style: Quiet intensity, almost grave. Measured but not slow. The weight of what she's discussing lives in her voice. Final phrase spoken with quiet conviction, not anger.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、市民が、撃たれた、痛ましい歴史、論文で、丁寧に、扱われていましたね、本当に、感動的でした、桜さん、研究の質、本当に、立派でした、本当に、評価できます、絶対。
lines.en: The painful history of civilians being shot during wartime — you handled that so carefully in your paper. It was genuinely moving. The quality of your research was truly excellent. I really can evaluate that with confidence.
lines.style: Warm closing, steady and assured. Slight softening on 'genuinely moving.' Final sentence spoken with quiet confidence, not defensiveness. Voice settles into respect.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。平和を、説く現代の活動家、本当に、立派な、人々ですね、論文の終わりで、扱いました、本当に、希望、感じる結論、書けました、私、感謝しております、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The modern activists who advocate for peace — they're really admirable people. I addressed them at the end of my paper. I was able to write a conclusion that held hope. I'm genuinely grateful.
lines.style: Gentle close, slight opening in the voice. Slower, reflective pace. Small smile in the voice on 'grateful.' Trailing slightly upward with quiet relief, like she's found words for something she felt.
